explanation: It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and nonzero only at D1 when the previous trial was an a1 choice that reached S1 by the common transition and went unrewarded; it stays 0 if the previous trial was a rare transition, an a2 choice, or rewarded. In that case it is about 10 if the trial before that was also unrewarded, and about 3-6 if the trial before was rewarded (for example, the first miss after a run of rewards on a1).
